leadText:
Kira (Japanese: キーラ Keira) is a character of the day who appeared in Raid Battle in The Ruins!. She is a .

Kira was first seen when and Goh were wondering how to cross the hot sands of the Desert Resort, which were too hot to cross by foot. She gave them advice on the best way to get across, leading them to use their Pokémon to sled across the resort. Kira later saved Ash from a trap he inadvertently triggered while exploring the Colossus Ruins in the Desert Resort and joined Ash and Goh in exploring the ruins.

During the exploration, they came across two , and based on their movements, Kira figured out that someone was trapped inside of them. Ash had attack them, causing Shane Seeker and his to be freed from them. Later, the group came across a room, solved a puzzle, and had to deal with a . Kira battled it alongside Ash, Goh, Shane Seeker, and the excavation in a Raid Battle, which ended when Goh Golurk. Continuing their exploration, they discovered a room filled with gold.

She reappeared in a flashback in Battling in the Freezing Raid!.
